changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6349-types-internal-name-collisions-batch-2.md`

- names `data-protocol.ts` → `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts` — edited by this change

  > **`ValidationFunction` — renamed to `FieldValidationFunction` in `field-types.ts`.** `data-protocol.ts` declares `(value, context?: ValidationContext) => boolean | string`; `field-types.ts` declared `(value) => boolean | string | PromiseANGLE-BRACKETS(boolean | string)`. They disagree at both ends of the arrow — different parameter lists, and a `Promise` return that the data-protocol signature does not admit — so field-types' is not assignable to data-protocol's in the direction that matters. `data-protocol.ts` had said so in prose ("may differ from similarly named validation function types in other packages (e.g., in `field-types`)") for as long as both existed. The published names `ValidationFunction` (data-protocol's) and `FieldValidationFunction` (field-types') are unchanged.

### `.changeset/uniqueness-deprecation-jsdoc-4765.md`

- names `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts` → `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts` — edited by this change

  > Corrects the `@deprecated` prescription on `UniquenessValidation` in `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts`, which pointed authors at spellings the platform no longer accepts (objectui#4765).

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Angle-bracketed names in the quoted prose above are rewritten as `ANGLE-BRACKETS(name)`: GitHub deletes tag-shaped fragments from a stored body, and a quote that silently loses the identifier it is about is worse than a visible repair.

Compared the checked-out tree with `f9d772b16` (merge-base with origin/main): 8 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1538 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2124 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36186518605)

### ① Derived judgments

- **Premise, re-measured at head (merge-base `bc97f9247`).** `git grep` over the whole head tree (CHANGELOGs excluded) for `\bValidationEngine\b`, `defaultValidationEngine`, `\bvalidateFields\b` and the path `validation-engine` — `ObjectValidationEngine` / `object-validation-engine` hits excluded — returns only this PR's own prose (the three changesets, the `validation/index.ts` carve-out, the `data-protocol.ts` doc). No import clause from `@object-ui/core` names a bare `validate` (lit control: `validateSchema` imported from core in `skills/objectui/guides/testing.md`); no `export * from '@object-ui/core'` anywhere; the one namespace import (`packages/react/src/utils/nonGridRowCeiling.test.tsx`) reads other names; no `window`/`globalThis` exposure; no `require()` of core. `packages/core/package.json` `exports` is `"."` only (no subpath), `files` is `dist` and the build is bare `tsc` — no UMD/IIFE/global bundle. Sibling `/home/user/objectstack` working tree: no reference to the four names and no import from `@object-ui/core` (one local out-of-repo reading, not a population). Zero production consumers holds.
- **Exactly four.** Published `@object-ui/core@17.6.0` `dist/validation/validation-engine.d.ts` declares `class ValidationEngine`, `const defaultValidationEngine`, `function validate`, `function validateFields` and nothing else; `dist/validation/index.d.ts` re-exports it via `export * from './validation-engine.js'`. The retirement removes nothing the ruling did not name: the seven types the engine imported (`AdvancedValidationSchema`, `AdvancedValidationRule`, `ValidationFunction`, `AsyncValidationFunction`, `ValidationContext`, `AdvancedValidationResult`, `AdvancedValidationError`) are declared in `@object-ui/types` `data-protocol.ts`, still exported from its index, and untouched except the `locale` doc comment. Re-measured: after this change nothing under `packages/*/src`, `apps/`, `examples/` reads any of them — the family is now zero-reader public API (see ③).
- **#3110 stays.** `validation-engine-stays-unwired.test.ts` is not in the diff and is green at head (in the 4-test head run below). The rewritten carve-out names `schema-validator.js` only, still calls `validators/` deprecated under #3110, and its new paragraph (engine retired under objectui#7659, field rules compiled by `buildValidationRules` in `@object-ui/fields`) is true.
- **The pin, re-run in a scratch worktree at head (node_modules borrowed), under the shared verify lock (held 54s).** Head: `vitest run` pin + stays-unwired → `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 4 passed (4)`; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 0, `--listFilesOnly` lists the pin (1) among 173 core test files. Base `bc97f9247` + pin: `Tests 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`, received `['ValidationEngine', …(3)]`; tsc exit 2, 4 × TS2578 at the four `@ts-expect-error` lines. Ablation at head: base engine restored (blob `67b32db01` = base blob), export line re-planted (`index.ts` blob `b3e4e60a9` → `02acae16a`, anchor 1, replacement 0 → 1) → same 1 failed / 4 × TS2578. Restore proven: `index.ts` blob = HEAD `b3e4e60a9`, engine file absent, `git status --porcelain` empty, pin green again. CI's `Type Check` job runs core's `type-check` script, which chains `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the compile-time half is gated.
- **The two out-of-surface edits.** Both comment-only (eslint errors/warnings head vs base: `index.ts` 0/0, `renderer.tsx` 0/14, `data-protocol.ts` 0/44, identical). `data-protocol.ts` `ValidationContext.locale`: true — the base engine's `date_min` / `date_max` branches called `toLocaleDateString(context?.locale)`, and no reader remains in core. `plugin-timeline/src/renderer.tsx`: **not true after the edit.** The surviving sentence reads "It is this repo's idiom for the question (see `components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`)", but `data-table.tsx` contains no `instanceof Date` at head or at base — it lost it in `4758b33c2` (objectui#10625, PR #10671), an ancestor of the merge-base. The PR deleted the one pointer that was true (the engine had ten `instanceof Date` sites) and kept the stale one as the sole example. The idiom is live in `toDay` in `packages/components/src/renderers/form/calendar.tsx` (`return value instanceof Date ? value : undefined;`). Replacement for the two lines:
  ```

  ```
- **Wording left in the edited barrel, and it ships.** `packages/core/src/validation/index.ts` still opens with ` * Phase 3.5: Validation engine`, four lines above the paragraph saying the validation engine was retired; the 17.6.0 tarball shows this file-level docblock is emitted verbatim into `dist/validation/index.d.ts`, reachable from the entry type graph. ### ② Semver level

- `'@object-ui/core': minor` with a BREAKING banner is the fixed group's rule (objectui AGENTS.md: no `major` in a changeset; breaking changes take `minor` with the breaking semantics in the body; `Changeset Bump Policy` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` green on head). The banner names all four removed exports and the replacement `buildValidationRules` (`@object-ui/fields`).
- **Not like-for-like, and the changeset says so.** `validateFields(values, schemas)` was an imperative async evaluator over `AdvancedValidationSchema` rule lists (snake_case rule types, registered custom/async validators, cross-field rules) returning per-field results; `buildValidationRules(field)` compiles field metadata (`required`, `minLength`/`maxLength`, `min`/`max`, `pattern`, email/url by type, `validate`, location) into react-hook-form rules. The body states "There is no one-to-one port of an `AdvancedValidationSchema` object … declares those constraints on the field metadata instead, or keeps its own check." No wording change needed. "Out-of-repository consumers are NOT MEASURED" is stated.

(Pre-existing, out of scope: `packages/core/README.md` "✅ Validation - Zod-based schema validation" is the same false "Zod" claim the PR corrected in section 5; `schema-validator.ts` imports no zod.)

"This PR writes no label" — the label is now on the PR (③). No angle brackets, no line-address citations, no model identifier in body or changeset; `Fixes #7659` is the intended close.

The dev noted it "not filed"; it is a Clause-② public-type removal and deserves a card rather than an acceptance note.
